The user wants me to return JSON only, with onboarding copy for a Traditional Chinese expense tracking app. Three pages:
1. Link bank accounts to auto-import transactions
2. Auto-categorize expenses
3. Monthly budget reminders
Last page has a CTA button "開始使用" (Get started).

They specified the JSON keys: t1, b1, t2, b2, t3, b3, cta.

I should write concise, friendly Traditional Chinese copy. Each page: title (t) and subtitle (b). CTA: "開始使用" or slightly more engaging like "開始記帳吧" — but they said the button is "開始使用". I can use "開始使用" or a variation. Let me write clean copy.

t1: "連結你的銀行帳戶" / b1: "自動匯入每筆交易，記帳從此不用手動輸入"
t2: "支出自動分類" / b2: "AI 為每筆消動歸類，消費狀況一目了然"
t3: "每月預算提醒" / b3: "設定預算，快超支時即時提醒你"
cta: "開始使用"

Only JSON, no other text. Make sure Traditional Chinese characters. Avoid simplified. "動" etc. Check: "消費" fine. "一目了然" fine.

Return just JSON.</think>{"t1":"連結銀行帳戶","b1":"自動匯入每筆交易，記帳不必手動輸入","t2":"支出自動分類","b2":"每筆消費聰明歸類，花費流向一目了然","t3":"每月預算提醒","b3":"設定預算目標，快超支時即時通知你","cta":"開始使用"}
